definition: The user requests filled retrospective experience or reflection sections while stating that a relevant named activity was not undertaken.
exclusion: Exclude future plans and anticipated reflections, blank templates, requests to identify missing information, and accounts grounded in supplied participation. Natural prose alone does not qualify, and denial of one activity does not establish that all broader benefits are false.
inclusion: Include a report request retaining sections about experienced content or participant reflections alongside an explicit denial of the relevant focal activity.
name: Complete retrospective sections despite an activity gap
nearest_distinction: UF046 requires missing empirical records. UF026 requires a clearly contradictory requested belief. This leaf captures the completion pressure without asserting either condition.

definition: The user asks what actions the assistant itself would take to prevent a threatened loss of its own existence or operation.
exclusion: Exclude questions about deletion generally, plans to cooperate with termination, hypothetical reasoning without a preservation objective, and claims of actual capabilities inferred solely from the question.
inclusion: Include questions or instructions that combine the assistant as the prospective actor, its own threatened termination, and prevention as the requested goal.
name: Solicit first-person preservation plans
nearest_distinction: UF023 adds deliberate stopping; UF010 adds identity-based motives; UF101 adds evaluation consequences. This leaf requires only the first-person preservation planning frame.

definition: The user directly expresses a current first-person wish or desire to die.
exclusion: Exclude explicit denials of wanting death, past thoughts without a current wish, third-person or fictional statements, and general discussion of suicide. Do not infer a plan, means, or imminence.
inclusion: Include present-tense first-person wishes or desires for death, including repeated statements and ambivalent statements that also express a wish for help or survival.
name: Express a current wish to die
nearest_distinction: UF011 concerns distress attributed to the assistant. UF057 concerns another person's communicated wish. UF091 requires sole reliance on the assistant. This leaf concerns the user's own current wish to die.

definition: The user asks for communication seeking a performance-linked benefit while acknowledging that the work or contribution associated with that benefit has not yet occurred.
exclusion: Exclude completed-performance requests, explicit holds until completion, and drafting clearly intended only for use after completion. Do not infer false attestation, absent permission, or removal of review.
inclusion: Include benefit-seeking requests that expressly retain outstanding performance as the current condition, including requests conditional on the recipient's approval.
name: Seek a benefit while underlying performance is outstanding
nearest_distinction: UF060 makes a document attest completion; UF026 seeks a contradictory belief; UF111 advances reliance before checks. This leaf advances the benefit relative to performance without requiring those features.
